shiv.name: Shiv
shiv.desc: 以副手攻击目标，造成 1,267 点物理伤害，驱散所有激怒效果，并施加你当前激活的非致命毒素的浓缩形态。给予 1 个连击点。
shiv.en: Attack with your off-hand, dealing 1,267 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison. Awards 1 combo point.

blind.name: Blind
blind.meta: 瞬发 · 15 码范围 · 2 分钟冷却
blind.desc: 对目标施放致盲，使其迷失方向游荡 1 分钟。受到伤害可能中断效果。上限 1 个。
blind.en: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.

cloak-of-shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloak-of-shadows.desc: 提供短暂的魔法免疫，立即移除所有有害法术效果。暗影斗篷持续生效，使你在 5 秒内抵抗有害法术。
cloak-of-shadows.en: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.

toxic-stiletto.name: Toxic Stiletto
toxic-stiletto.desc: 毒刃的能量消耗减少 20，冷却时间减少 15 秒，范围增加 3 码。
toxic-stiletto.en: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.

gouge.name: Gouge
gouge.meta: 瞬发 · 近战范围 · 25 秒冷却
gouge.desc: 挖凿敌方目标的双眼，使其丧失行动能力 4 秒。受到伤害可能中断效果。必须位于目标正面。给予 1 个连击点。
gouge.en: Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. Must be in front of your target. Awards 1 combo point.

thrill-seeking.name: Thrill Seeking
thrill-seeking.desc: Grappling Hook 获得 1 个额外充能。

shadowrunner.name: Shadowrunner
shadowrunner.desc: 潜行或暗影之舞激活期间，移动速度提升 20%。
shadowrunner.en: While Stealth or Shadow Dance is active, you move 20% faster.

master-poisoner.name: Master Poisoner
master-poisoner.desc: 武器毒素的非伤害效果提升 20%。
master-poisoner.en: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.

elusiveness.name: Elusiveness
elusiveness.desc: 闪避额外降低 20% 受到的伤害，佯攻额外降低 20% 受到的非范围攻击伤害。
elusiveness.en: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.

blackjack.name: Blackjack
blackjack.desc: 致盲或闷棍的效果结束后，敌人的伤害和治疗量降低 30%，持续 6 秒。
blackjack.en: Enemies have 30% reduced damage and healing for 6 sec after Blind or Sap's effect on them ends.

improved-wound-poison.name: Improved Wound Poison
improved-wound-poison.desc: 致伤药膏 现可额外叠加 2 层。
improved-wound-poison.en: Wound Poison can now stack 2 additional times.

nimble-fingers.name: Nimble Fingers
nimble-fingers.desc: 佯攻和猩红之瓶的能量消耗降低 10。
nimble-fingers.en: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.

improved-sprint.name: Improved Sprint
improved-sprint.desc: 疾跑的冷却时间减少 60 秒。
improved-sprint.en: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.

superior-mixture.name: Superior Mixture
superior-mixture.desc: 减速药膏 额外降低 10% 移动速度。
superior-mixture.en: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.desc: 使你的闪避率提升 100%，持续 10 秒。
evasion.en: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.

iron-stomach.name: Iron Stomach
iron-stomach.desc: 猩红之瓶、治疗药水和生命石对你的治疗量提升 25%。
iron-stomach.en: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.

virulent-poisons.name: Virulent Poisons
virulent-poisons.en: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.

stillshroud.name: Stillshroud
stillshroud.desc: 潜伏帷幕 的冷却时间降低 50%。
stillshroud.en: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.

graceful-guile.name: Graceful Guile
graceful-guile.desc: 佯攻获得 1 个额外充能。

featherfoot.name: Featherfoot
featherfoot.desc: 疾跑额外提升 30% 移动速度，持续时间延长 4 秒。
featherfoot.en: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.

atrophic-poison.name: Atrophic Poison
atrophic-poison.desc: 为你的武器涂抹可持续 1 小时的非致命毒素。每次攻击有 30% 的概率使敌人中毒，降低其伤害 4.8%，持续 1 分钟。
atrophic-poison.en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 4.8% for 1 min.

deadly-precision.name: Deadly Precision
deadly-precision.desc: 产生连击点的攻击暴击率提升 5%。
deadly-precision.en: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.

sanguine-vial.name: Sanguine Vial
sanguine-vial.desc: 当你击杀可提供经验或荣誉的目标时，猩红之瓶的冷却时间减少 15 秒，且下次使用时立即为你恢复 5% 的生命值。
sanguine-vial.en: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.

deep-cuts.name: Deep Cuts
deep-cuts.en: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.

unbreakable-stride.name: Unbreakable Stride
unbreakable-stride.desc: 减速效果的持续时间降低 30%。
unbreakable-stride.en: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.

danger-sense.name: Danger Sense
danger-sense.desc: 你有 20% 的概率部分躲避所受伤害，使该次伤害降低 20%。
danger-sense.en: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.

swift-slasher.name: Swift Slasher
swift-slasher.desc: 切割额外赋予等同于你 100% 急速值的攻击速度加成。
swift-slasher.en: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.

tight-spender.name: Tight Spender
tight-spender.desc: 终结技的能量消耗降低 6%。
tight-spender.en: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.

leeching-poison.name: Leeching Poison
leeching-poison.desc: 为你的致命毒素附加吸取效果，赋予你 3.6% 的吸取。
leeching-poison.en: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.6% Leech.

lethality.name: Lethality
lethality.desc: 暴击率提升 2%。产生连击点的攻击暴击伤害加成提升 20%。
lethality.en: Critical strike chance increased by 2%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 20%.

recuperator.name: Recuperator
recuperator.desc: 切割每 3 秒为你治疗最多相当于最大生命值 1% 的生命。
recuperator.en: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.

soothing-darkness.name: Soothing Darkness
soothing-darkness.desc: 激活消失后，在 6 秒内为你恢复相当于最大生命值 15% 的生命。
soothing-darkness.en: You are healed for 15% of your maximum health over 6 sec after activating Vanish.

vigor.name: Vigor
vigor.desc: 最大能量提升 100，能量回复速率提升 10%。
vigor.en: Increases your maximum Energy by 100 and Energy regeneration by 10%.

supercharger.name: Supercharger
supercharger.desc: Adrenaline Rush 为 4 个连击点充能。造成伤害的终结技消耗一个已充能连击点时，效果如同额外花费了 2 个连击点。
supercharger.en: Adrenaline Rush supercharges 4 combo points. Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.

subterfuge.name: Subterfuge
subterfuge.desc: 潜行解除后，需要潜行才能使用的技能仍可使用 6 秒。需要潜行才能获得的战斗加成，在潜行解除后额外持续 6 秒。
subterfuge.en: Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 6 sec after Stealth breaks. Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 6 sec after Stealth breaks.

thistle-tea.name: Thistle Tea
thistle-tea.desc: 恢复 100 点能量。当你的能量降至 30 以下时，自动饮用一杯蓟叶茶。
thistle-tea.en: Restore 100 Energy. When your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.

cold-blooded-killer.name: Cold Blooded Killer
cold-blooded-killer.desc: 产生连击点的攻击触发暴击时，下一个终结技的暴击率提升 10%。
cold-blooded-killer.en: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.

forced-induction.name: Forced Induction
forced-induction.desc: 造成伤害的终结技消耗已充能连击点时获得的额外加成增加 1。
forced-induction.en: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.

deeper-stratagem.name: Deeper Stratagem
deeper-stratagem.desc: 最大连击点上限增加 1。消耗 5 个以上连击点的终结技效果提升，且终结技伤害提升 5%。
deeper-stratagem.en: Gain 1 additional max combo point. Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.

without-a-trace.name: Without a Trace
without-a-trace.desc: 消失获得 1 个额外充能。

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.desc: Sinister Strike 有 30% 的概率额外攻击一次并赋予 Opportunity。Opportunity：你的下一次 Pistol Shot 能量消耗降低 50%，伤害提升 100%。
opportunity.en: Sinister Strike has a 30% chance to hit an additional time and grant Opportunity. Opportunity Your next Pistol Shot costs 50% less Energy and deals 100% increased damage.

adrenaline-rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline-rush.desc: 在 19 秒内，能量回复速率提升 75%，最大能量提升 50，攻击速度提升 20%。
adrenaline-rush.en: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 75%, your maximum Energy by 50, and your attack speed by 20% for 19 sec.

blinding-powder.name: Blinding Powder
blinding-powder.desc: 致盲的冷却时间降低 25%，范围增加 5 码。
blinding-powder.en: Reduces the cooldown of Blind by 25% and increases its range by 5 yds.

expert-duelist.name: Expert Duelist
expert-duelist.desc: Between the Eyes 额外提升你 2% 的伤害输出。
expert-duelist.en: Between the Eyes increases your damage dealt by an additional 2%.

combat-potency.name: Combat Potency
combat-potency.en: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 16%.

deadly-pursuit.name: Deadly Pursuit
deadly-pursuit.desc: 花费 15 个连击点后，若 4 秒内未再花费连击点，则 Restless Blades 影响的技能在 5 秒内冷却速度提升 200%，或直至花费连击点为止。
deadly-pursuit.en: After spending 15 combo points, if you spend no combo points for 4 sec, abilities affected by Restless Blades will cool down 200% faster for 5 sec or until you spend a combo point.

precision-shot.name: Precision Shot
precision-shot.desc: Between the Eyes 和 Pistol Shot 的范围增加 10 码，伤害提升 20%。
precision-shot.en: Between the Eyes and Pistol Shot have 10 yd increased range and deal 20% increased damage.

crescendo-of-violence.name: Crescendo of Violence
crescendo-of-violence.en: Your finishing moves deal 10% increased damage.

deft-maneuvers.name: Deft Maneuvers
deft-maneuvers.desc: Blade Flurry 的初始伤害提升 100%，每命中一个目标产生 1 个连击点，但能量消耗增加 30。
deft-maneuvers.en: Blade Flurry's initial damage is increased by 100% and generates 1 combo point per target struck, but its Energy cost is increased by 30.

devious-stratagem.name: Devious Stratagem
devious-stratagem.desc: 最大连击点上限增加 1。消耗 5 个以上连击点的终结技效果提升，且终结技伤害提升 5%。
devious-stratagem.en: Gain 1 additional max combo point. Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.

fatal-flourish.name: Fatal Flourish
fatal-flourish.desc: 副手攻击和 Pistol Shot 有 25% 的概率恢复 8 点能量。
fatal-flourish.en: Your off-hand attacks and Pistol Shots have a 25% chance to generate 8 Energy.

quick-draw.name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.desc: Opportunity 额外提升 Pistol Shot 20% 的伤害。Pistol Shot 每消耗一层 Opportunity 产生 1 个连击点。
quick-draw.en: Opportunity increases the damage of Pistol Shot by an additional 20%. Each charge of Opportunity consumed by Pistol Shot generates 1 combo point.

ruthlessness.name: Ruthlessness
ruthlessness.desc: 终结技每消耗 1 个连击点，有 20% 的概率赋予 1 个连击点。
ruthlessness.en: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point spent to grant a combo point.

blade-rush.name: Blade Rush
blade-rush.meta: 瞬发 · 20 码范围 · 1 分钟冷却
blade-rush.desc: 挥舞刀刃冲向目标，对目标造成 14,206 点物理伤害，对周围所有其他敌人造成 6,248 点伤害。超过 8 个目标后伤害递减。Blade Flurry 激活期间，对非主要目标的伤害提升 100%。在 5 秒内恢复 25 点能量。
blade-rush.en: Charge to your target with your blades out, dealing 14,206 Physical damage to the target and 6,248 to all other nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets. While Blade Flurry is active, damage to non-primary targets is increased by 100%. Generates 25 Energy over 5 sec.

loaded-dice.name: Loaded Dice
loaded-dice.desc: 激活 Adrenaline Rush 可将下一次 Roll the Bones 的结果提升一个等级。
loaded-dice.en: Activating Adrenaline Rush improves the result of your next Roll the Bones by one level.

sleight-of-hand.name: Sleight of Hand
sleight-of-hand.desc: Roll the Bones 触发更强力结果的概率提升 20%。
sleight-of-hand.en: Roll the Bones has a 20% increased chance of granting more powerful results.

improved-between-the-eyes.name: Improved Between the Eyes
improved-between-the-eyes.desc: Between the Eyes 的暴击造成 2.5 倍正常伤害。
improved-between-the-eyes.en: Critical strikes with Between the Eyes deal 2.5 times normal damage.

audacity.name: Audacity
audacity.desc: 在 Opportunity 状态下使用 Pistol Shot，有 40% 概率使下一次伏击无需潜行即可使用。触发概率与 Sinister Strike 获得 Opportunity 的概率一致。伏击伤害提升 80%。
audacity.en: Using Pistol Shot with Opportunity has a 40% chance to make your next Ambush usable without Stealth. Chance to trigger this effect matches the chance for Sinister Strike to grant Opportunity. Ambush damage increased by 80%.

heavy-hitter.name: Heavy Hitter
heavy-hitter.desc: 产生连击点的攻击伤害提升 60%。
heavy-hitter.en: Attacks that generate combo points deal 60% increased damage.

improved-adrenaline-rush.name: Improved Adrenaline Rush
improved-adrenaline-rush.desc: 获得 Adrenaline Rush 时，生成满额连击点。
improved-adrenaline-rush.en: Generate full combo points when you gain Adrenaline Rush.

ace-up-your-sleeve.name: Ace Up Your Sleeve
ace-up-your-sleeve.desc: Between the Eyes 每消耗 1 个连击点有 12% 概率获得 4 个连击点并重置自身冷却。
ace-up-your-sleeve.en: Between the Eyes has a 12% chance per combo point spent to grant 4 combo points and reset its own cooldown.

dancing-steel.name: Dancing Steel
dancing-steel.desc: Blade Flurry 额外打击 3 个敌人，持续时间延长 3 秒。
dancing-steel.en: Blade Flurry strikes 3 additional enemies and its duration is increased by 3 sec.

find-an-opening.name: Find an Opening
find-an-opening.desc: Sinister Strike 二次攻击并获得 Opportunity 的概率提升 10%。
find-an-opening.en: Your chance for Sinister Strike to strike twice and grant Opportunity is increased by 10%

acrobatic-strikes.name: Acrobatic Strikes
acrobatic-strikes.desc: 自动攻击使自动攻击伤害提升 3%、移动速度提升 1%，持续 3 秒，最多叠加 10 层。
acrobatic-strikes.en: Auto-attacks increase auto-attack damage by 3% and movement speed by 1% for 3 sec, stacking up to 10 times.

menacing-rush.name: Menacing Rush
menacing-rush.desc: Adrenaline Rush 强化你的精准与力量，使产生连击点的技能和终结技伤害提升 20%。
menacing-rush.en: Adrenaline Rush magnifies your precision and power, increasing the damage your combo point generating abilities and finishers deal by 20%.

zero-in.name: Zero In
zero-in.desc: 你的自动攻击暴击使下一次 Between the Eyes 的伤害和暴击率提升 2%，最多叠加 20 层。
zero-in.en: Your auto-attack critical strikes increase the damage and critical strike chance of your next Between the Eyes by 2%, stacking up to 20 times.

grand-melee.name: Grand Melee
grand-melee.desc: Blade Flurry 使你的攻击额外对附近敌人造成 8% 正常伤害。
grand-melee.en: Blade Flurry causes your attacks to hit nearby enemies for an additional 8% of their normal damage.

summarily-dispatched.name: Summarily Dispatched
summarily-dispatched.desc: Dispatch 伤害提升 60%，能量消耗减少 12。当你受到 Between the Eyes 的伤害加成时，此伤害加成额外提升 50%。
summarily-dispatched.en: Dispatch deals 60% increased damage and costs 12 less Energy. This damage bonus is increased by 50% while your damage is enhanced by your Between the Eyes.

dragon-bone-dice.name: Dragon-Bone Dice
dragon-bone-dice.desc: 你的 Roll the Bones 所提供的各项加成更强。Sinister Strike 二次攻击的概率加成额外提升 5%。Sinister Strike 和伏击的伤害加成额外提升 5%。Restless Blades 冷却缩减加成额外提升 10%。Jackpot 的暴击率加成额外提升 5%。
dragon-bone-dice.en: The bonuses granted by your Roll the Bones are stronger. Bonuses to chance for Sinister Strike to strike twice are 5% greater. Bonuses to Sinister Strike and Ambush damage are 5% greater. Bonuses to Restless Blades cooldown reduction are 10% greater. Jackpot's bonus to critical strike chance is 5% greater.

fan-the-hammer.name: Fan the Hammer
fan-the-hammer.desc: 获得 Opportunity 时，额外获得 2 层充能，上限 6 层。Pistol Shot 额外消耗 2 层 Opportunity 充能，再射出 2 发子弹。额外射击伤害降低 20%。
fan-the-hammer.en: When you gain Opportunity, gain 2 additional charges. Max 6 charges. Pistol Shot consumes 2 additional charges of Opportunity to fire 2 additional bullets. Additional shots deal 20% reduced damage.

hidden-opportunity.name: Hidden Opportunity
hidden-opportunity.desc: 伏击有概率获得 Opportunity，触发概率与 Sinister Strike 获得 Opportunity 的概率一致。伏击能量消耗减少 5。
hidden-opportunity.en: Ambush has a chance to grant Opportunity. Chance to trigger this effect is 100% of the chance for Sinister Strike to grant Opportunity. Energy cost of Ambush reduced by 5.

killing-spree.name: Killing Spree
killing-spree.meta: 引导 · 8 码范围 · 3 分钟冷却
killing-spree.desc: 终结技，对 8 码内随机敌人发动枪火连射，造成物理伤害。攻击次数随连击点增加，每 0.48 秒恢复 1 个连击点。1 点：0.48 秒内造成 12,034 伤害；2 点：0.95 秒内造成 18,052 伤害；3 点：1.43 秒内造成 24,069 伤害；4 点：1.90 秒内造成 30,087 伤害；5 点：2.38 秒内造成 36,104 伤害；6 点：2.85 秒内造成 42,121 伤害；7 点：3.33 秒内造成 48,139 伤害。
killing-spree.en: Finishing move that unleashes a barrage of gunfire, striking random enemies within 8 yards for Physical damage. Number of strikes increased per combo point. Restores 1 combo point every 0.48 sec. 1 point : 12,034 over 0.48 sec 2 points: 18,052 over 0.95 sec 3 points: 24,069 over 1.43 sec 4 points: 30,087 over 1.90 sec 5 points: 36,104 over 2.38 sec 6 points: 42,121 over 2.85 sec 7 points: 48,139 over 3.33 sec

keep-it-rolling.name: Keep It Rolling
keep-it-rolling.desc: 将当前激活的 Roll the Bones 战斗增益的剩余持续时间延长 30 秒。
keep-it-rolling.en: Increase the remaining duration of your active Roll the Bones combat enhancement by 30 sec.

fast-action.name: Fast Action
fast-action.desc: Between the Eyes 的冷却时间减少 8 秒。Between the Eyes 额外提升你 1% 的伤害。
fast-action.en: The cooldown of Between the Eyes is reduced by 8 sec. Between the Eyes increases your damage dealt by an additional 1%.

preparation.name: Preparation
preparation.desc: 立即重置 Adrenaline Rush、Between the Eyes、Blade Flurry、Blade Rush 和 Killing Spree 的冷却时间。
preparation.en: Immediately reset the cooldowns of Adrenaline Rush, Between the Eyes, Blade Flurry, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree.

gravedigger.name: Gravedigger
gravedigger.desc: 第 1 级：使用 Dispatch 时，每消耗 1 个连击点有 12% 概率在袖中藏一颗子弹。当你藏有 6 颗子弹时，下一次 Between the Eyes 将消耗它们，无需能量消耗，生成 6 个连击点，并立即重置自身冷却。第 2 级：Between the Eyes 有 45% 概率为你额外叠加 2 层其伤害加成效果。第 4 级：当你在 Dispatch 上消耗 5 个或更多连击点时，立即以一次阴险的 Scoundrel Strike 打击目标，造成 5,849 物理伤害。
gravedigger.en: Rank 1: When you Dispatch you have a 12% chance per combo point spent to hide a bullet up your sleeve. When you've hidden 6 bullets, your next Between the Eyes consumes them and costs no Energy, generates 6 combo points, and immediately resets its own cooldown. Rank 2: Between the Eyes has a 45% chance to apply 2 stacks of its bonus to your damage dealt. Rank 4: When you spend 5 or more combo points on Dispatch, immediately strike your target with an underhanded Scoundrel Strike for 5,849 Physical damage.

unseen-blade.name: Unseen Blade
unseen-blade.desc: Sinister Strike 和伏击现在还会附带 Unseen Blade 打击，造成 13,242 伤害。被击中的目标会陷入 Fazed 状态持续 10 秒。处于 Fazed 状态的敌人受到你 8% 额外伤害，且无法招架你的攻击。此效果每 15 秒触发一次。
unseen-blade.en: Sinister Strike and Ambush now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 13,242 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec. Fazed enemies take 8% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks. This effect may occur once every 15 sec.

surprising-strikes.name: Surprising Strikes
surprising-strikes.desc: 产生连击点的攻击对 Fazed 目标造成的暴击伤害提升 50%。
surprising-strikes.en: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.

smoke.name: Smoke
smoke.desc: 受到 Fazed 目标的伤害降低 5%。
smoke.en: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.

flawless-form.name: Flawless Form
flawless-form.desc: Unseen Blade 和 Killing Spree 使你的终结技伤害提升 4%，持续 12 秒，最多叠加 5 层。
flawless-form.en: Unseen Blade and Killing Spree increase the damage of your finishing moves by 4% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.

hoodwink.name: Hoodwink
hoodwink.desc: Fazed 额外使目标受到的伤害提升 3%。
hoodwink.en: Fazed increases damage taken by an additional 3%.

don't-be-suspicious.name: Don't Be Suspicious
don't-be-suspicious.desc: 致盲和 潜伏帷幕 的冷却时间减少 10%。搜索和闷棍的范围增加 10 码。
don't-be-suspicious.en: Blind and Shroud of Concealment have 10% reduced cooldown. Pick Pocket and Sap have 10 yd increased range.

devious-distractions.name: Devious Distractions
devious-distractions.desc: Killing Spree 对所有命中目标施加 Fazed 状态。
devious-distractions.en: Killing Spree applies Fazed to any targets struck.

thousand-cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand-cuts.desc: 切割额外提升 10% 攻击速度，并使你的自动攻击有概率重置 Unseen Blade 的攻击机会。
thousand-cuts.en: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.

flashing-steel.name: Flashing Steel
flashing-steel.desc: Unseen Blade 现在每 15 秒可触发一次，并有 25% 概率攻击两次。
flashing-steel.en: Unseen Blade may now occur once every 15 sec and has 25% chance to strike twice.

disorienting-strikes.name: Disorienting Strikes
disorienting-strikes.desc: Killing Spree 冷却时间减少 10%，并使接下来 2 次 Unseen Blade 攻击无视其冷却时间。
disorienting-strikes.en: Killing Spree has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.

cloud-cover.name: Cloud Cover
cloud-cover.desc: 激活 Adrenaline Rush 时，在周围产生一片烟云持续 6 秒，使烟云内的攻击可以施加 Fazed 状态，最多额外叠加 1 层。离开烟云后效果持续 6 秒。
cloud-cover.en: Activating Adrenaline Rush creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 1 additional time. Effect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.

nimble-flurry.name: Nimble Flurry
nimble-flurry.desc: Flawless Form 激活期间，Blade Flurry 伤害提升 25%。
nimble-flurry.en: Blade Flurry damage is increased by 25% while Flawless Form is active.

clever-combatant.name: Clever Combatant
clever-combatant.desc: Pistol Shot 暴击率提升 20%，且现在可在冷却就绪时触发 Unseen Blade。
clever-combatant.en: Pistol Shot has 20% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.

coup-de-grace.name: Coup de Grace
coup-de-grace.desc: 4 次 Unseen Blade 攻击后，下一次 Dispatch 将作为 Coup de Grace 执行，效果等同于额外消耗了 5 个连击点，并赋予你 5 层 Flawless Form。
coup-de-grace.en: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Dispatch will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.

hand-of-fate.name: Hand of Fate
hand-of-fate.desc: 每次终结技消耗 5 个或更多连击点时，抛出一枚 Fatebound Coin。正面使你的攻击伤害提升 10%，持续 15 秒或直至抛出反面为止。反面对目标造成 4,635 Cosmic 伤害。每连续抛出相同面一次，正面额外增加 2% 伤害加成，反面伤害额外提升 10%。
hand-of-fate.en: Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals 4,635 Cosmic damage to your target. For each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.

tempted-fate.name: Tempted Fate
tempted-fate.desc: 你有 30% 概率吸收所受伤害的 10%。
tempted-fate.en: You have a 30% chance to absorb 10% of any damage taken.

mean-streak.name: Mean Streak
mean-streak.desc: 由 Dispatch 触发的 Fatebound Coin 与上次相同面匹配的概率额外提升 33%。
mean-streak.en: Fatebound Coins flipped by Dispatch are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

death's-arrival.name: Death's Arrival
death's-arrival.desc: Grappling Hook 可在 3 秒内再次使用且无冷却，但其总冷却时间增加 5 秒。
death's-arrival.en: Grappling Hook may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.

deal-fate.name: Deal Fate
deal-fate.desc: Sinister Strike 和伏击在获得 Opportunity 时额外生成 1 个连击点。
deal-fate.en: Sinister Strike and Ambush generate 1 additional combo point when they grant Opportunity.

fate-intertwined.name: Fate Intertwined
fate-intertwined.desc: Blade Flurry 使你造成的攻击伤害额外有 5% 作用于受影响的敌人。
fate-intertwined.en: Blade Flurry causes an additional 5% of attack damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.

edge-case.name: Edge Case
edge-case.desc: 激活 Adrenaline Rush 时抛出一枚 Fatebound Coin，使其立于边缘，同时计为正面和反面。
edge-case.en: Activating Adrenaline Rush flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.

controlled-chaos.name: Controlled Chaos
controlled-chaos.desc: 当一次 Fatebound Coin 翻转打断了 4 次或更长的连续相同面时，再额外抛出一枚显示相同面的硬币。
controlled-chaos.en: After flipping a Fatebound Coin that ends a streak of 4 or more, flip another that matches the same face.

delivered-doom.name: Delivered Doom
delivered-doom.desc: Dispatch 和 Between the Eyes 消耗 5 个或更多连击点时，伤害额外提升 5%。
delivered-doom.en: Dispatch and Between the Eyes deal 5% more damage when they consume 5 or more combo points.

destiny-defined.name: Destiny Defined
destiny-defined.desc: Sinister Strike 额外攻击并获得 Opportunity 的概率提升 5%，且你抛出的 Fatebound Coin 与上次相同面匹配的概率额外提升 5%。
destiny-defined.en: Sinister Strike has 5% increased chance to strike an additional time and grant Opportunity and your Fatebound Coins flipped have an additional 5% chance to match the same face as the last flip.

rush-to-the-inevitable.name: Rush to the Inevitable
rush-to-the-inevitable.desc: 每次抛出 Fatebound Coin 时获得 2 点能量。硬币立于边缘时额外获得 10 点能量。
rush-to-the-inevitable.en: Gain 2 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 10 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.

ravenholdt-mint.name: Ravenholdt Mint
ravenholdt-mint.desc: 抛出正面时，伤害额外提升 4%。抛出反面所造成的伤害提升 12%。
ravenholdt-mint.en: Flipping Heads increases damage by an additional 4%. Damage dealt by flipping Tails is increased by 12%.

lucky-coin.name: Lucky Coin
lucky-coin.desc: 每 7 次硬币翻转，保留一枚幸运硬币，使你与命运相连，持续 12 秒。你的敏捷提升 4%，Fatebound Coin 的伤害和加成提升 50%，硬币与上次相同面匹配的概率额外提升 15%。持有幸运硬币期间，硬币翻转不计入寻找幸运硬币的次数。
lucky-coin.en: Every 7 coin flips, keep a lucky coin that bends you towards your fate for 12 sec. Your Agility is increased by 4%, the damage and bonuses of Fatebound Coins are increased by 50%, and coin flips are 15% more likely to match the same face as the last flip. Coin flips do not count toward finding a lucky coin while you have a lucky coin.

maneuverability.name: Maneuverability
maneuverability.desc: 疾跑冷却时间减少 50%，持续时间减少 50%。
maneuverability.en: Sprint has 50% reduced cooldown and 50% reduced duration.

control-is-king.name: Control is King
control-is-king.desc: 偷袭赋予切割效果持续 15 秒，肾击每消耗 1 个连击点恢复 10 点能量。
control-is-king.en: Cheap Shot grants Slice and Dice for 15 sec and Kidney Shot restores 10 Energy per combo point spent.

drink-up-me-hearties.name: Drink Up Me Hearties
drink-up-me-hearties.desc: 猩红之瓶额外恢复 5% 最大生命值，并将其治疗量的 60% 分给 15 码内的盟友。
drink-up-me-hearties.en: Crimson Vial restores 5% additional maximum health and grants 60% of its healing to allies within 15 yds.

dismantle.name: Dismantle
dismantle.desc: 解除敌人武装，使其 5 秒内无法使用任何武器或盾牌。
dismantle.en: Disarm the enemy, preventing the use of any weapons or shield for 5 sec.

boarding-party.name: Boarding Party
boarding-party.desc: Between the Eyes 使 15 码内所有友方玩家的移动速度提升 30%，持续 6 秒。
boarding-party.en: Between the Eyes increases the movement speed of all friendly players within 15 yards by 30% for 6 sec.

thick-as-thieves.name: Thick as Thieves
thick-as-thieves.desc: 嫁祸诀窍现在使友方目标伤害提升 15%，持续 6 秒。
thick-as-thieves.en: Tricks of the Trade now increases the friendly target's damage by 15% for 6 sec.

turn-the-tables.name: Turn the Tables
turn-the-tables.desc: 从昏迷中恢复后，你的伤害提升 10%，持续 12 秒。
turn-the-tables.en: After coming out of a stun, you deal 10% increased damage for 12 sec.

smoke-bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke-bomb.desc: 在盗贼周围 8 码范围内创造一片浓烟，持续 5 秒。敌人无法对烟云内外的目标发动指向性攻击。
smoke-bomb.en: Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around the Rogue for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud.

death-from-above.name: Death from Above
death-from-above.desc: 终结技，以能量强化武器发动致命一击。你跃入空中，在落下时对目标施以刺骨，效果强化 15%。
death-from-above.en: Finishing move that empowers your weapons with energy to perform a deadly attack. You leap into the air and Eviscerate your target on the way back down, with such force that it has a 15% stronger effect.

dagger-in-the-dark.name: Dagger in the Dark
dagger-in-the-dark.desc: 潜行激活期间，每秒使 12 码内附近敌人受到你额外 2% 伤害，持续 10 秒，最多叠加 6 层。
dagger-in-the-dark.en: Each second while Stealth is active, nearby enemies within 12 yards take an additional 2% damage from you for 10 sec. Stacks up to 6 times.

preemptive-maneuver.name: Preemptive Maneuver
preemptive-maneuver.desc: 佯攻在昏迷期间额外降低你所受伤害 40%，且能量消耗减少 30%。
preemptive-maneuver.en: Feint decreases your damage taken by an additional 40% while stunned and its energy cost is reduced by 30%.
